items.quote: Our intent, I think I mentioned this in the past as well, is to reach a near double-digit growth in terms of performance by the company
items.statement: Aspire to near double-digit company growth; no date given
items.speaker: Karthik Yathindra

items.quote: And as we keep telling, we are very happy with the 19% to 21% EBITDA. And we are very confident we can be in that range
items.speaker: V.S. Ganesh

items.quote: We plan to spend around INR140 crores in FY '26
items.statement: FY26 capex of about INR 140 crore
items.speaker: Deepanjan B.

items.quote: for the year, we generally maintain a 4%, 4.5% budget
items.statement: Marketing budget of 4-4.5% for the year
items.speaker: V.S. Ganesh

tone.label: mixed
tone.why: Management admits first-half revenue has been subpar against internal targets, but is confident about the 19-21% EBITDA margin band and the capex and marketing budgets.
